question: India won the Border-Gavaskar trophy in 2023 by defeating ________ and qualified for the World Test championship Final.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Australia.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **India won the Border-Gavaskar trophy in 2023 by defeating Australia and qualified for the World Test championship Final.**
 
• Border-Gavaskar trophy is a **test cricket series played between India and Australia.**
 
• The 2023 series was played in India and consisted of** 4 test matches.**
 
• India won the series 2-1 with** one match ending in a draw.**
 
• Australia has won the Border-Gavaskar trophy 5 times while India has won it 10 times.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About Border Gavaskar Trophy**

 
 
• It is a Test cricket series played between India and Australia.
 
• It is named after Alan Border of Australia and Sunil Gavaskar of India.
 
• Number of teams - 2
 
• Current trophy holder - India (10th title)
 
• Most Runs - Sachin Tendulkar (3,235)
 
• Most wickets - Anil Kumble (105)
 
• Most successful - India (10 titles)
 
• First edition - 1996–97 (India)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/d/df/Border%E2%80%93Gavaskar_Trophy.jpg]
